text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High error rate from inference-prod us-east-1a (snat/conntrack anomalies). 30% of requests returning 502/504 for model-serving cluster inference-prod-g5. Auto-escalation to #incidents triggered. Incident ID: PD-8813 :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): acked. I'm pulling logs now, rerouting traffic if needed. tagging @Liam for network side.
Liam: on it. seeing conntrack saturation on nodes in az1a. ENIs showing `ConnectionReset` and `ERROR: conntrack table full` in host logs. pulling instance metrics.
Anya: are Dedicated customers impacted or just hosted? Maya - CS asked about tiered impact.
Maya - CS: we have 2 active Dedicated customers in us-east-1a with increased 5xx rate. One reported elevated tail latency ~1-2m ago. Customers: AcmeAnalytics (prod), BetaDocs (canary).
Sam (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) scale down pods on affected hosts 2) steer new requests to us-east-1b/c via routing policy 3) open AWS support case if ENI-level. Doing 1 & 2 now.
Liam: executing routing change: updating route policy to prefer us-east-1b for new inference sessions for shard-az=us-east-1a. Command run:```sh
redwoodctl route update --policy inference-region-prefer --weight us-east-1b=80 --weight us-east-1a=10 --dry-run=false
```
infra-bot: ROUTE UPDATE: policy inference-region-prefer changed by Liam at 2026-03-15T20:05:12Z. New weights applied.
Sam (oncall): cordoning affected instances to prevent new containers landing:```sh
kubectl drain node ip-10-0-45-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl drain node ip-10-0-45-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Liam: I've also bumped conntrack max on hosts to reduce immediate drops:```sh
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000
# persisted in /etc/sysctl.d/99-conntrack.conf
```
Anya: quick check — any model loads failing or K/V cache errors?
Sam (oncall): KV cache steady; model loads fine. Errors are TCP resets during session handshake to backend model workers. Likely SNAT conntrack exhaustion on host NAT path to model pool.
Maya - CS: prepping customer comms: short note ready to send to AcmeAnalytics: "We are seeing elevated 5xx for inference in us-east-1a. Traffic is being steered to other AZs; we expect reduced errors within 10-15m. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigation." Approve?
ops-shiftlead: approve the comms. include suggested mitigation steps customers can do (switch to cross-az routing or pin to multi-az).
Liam: AWS side: opened case #AWSC-37482 with EC2 NLB team. Noted ENI Rx drop spikes and high SNAT table usage on NAT instances. Requesting internal recommendation for permanent fix.
Sam (oncall): monitoring impact metrics: 5xx rate for inference-prod dropped from 32% -> 12% after route weights change. Tail latency improved for most sessions. Still seeing isolated errors tied to older sticky sessions pinned to us-east-1a.
Anya: can we invalidate sticky sessions quickly?
Sam (oncall): yes — rolling eviction for 20% of sticky cookies per minute via api-proxy:```json
{"action":"invalidate_sticky","percent":20}
```
infra-bot: STICKY INVALIDATION: started by Sam at 2026-03-15T20:12:40Z.
Maya - CS: customers on Dedicated — do we need to offer credits? AcmeAnalytics asking for expected downtime window.
ops-shiftlead: hold on credits until final RCA. Offer proactive assistance to move capacity to us-east-1b.
Liam: still seeing conntrack counters climb on hosts with heavy egress to some model-serving subnets. Long-term patch: increase conntrack, rework SNAT architecture or add more NAT instances with smart hashing. Filing follow-up task INFRA-1294.
Sam (oncall): next steps: 1) keep route weights favoring healthy AZs until AWS confirms fix 2) cordon/drain/recycle affected hosts when traffic low 3) follow up with customer-facing postmortem within 24h.
Anya: are there any customers currently fully blocked?
Maya - CS: BetaDocs reported degraded but not fully blocked; AcmeAnalytics had intermittent 502 spikes for ~12 minutes. We'll escalate further if SLA breach risk.
Liam: marking incident as mitigated for active customer impact. Keeping channel open for follow-up and RCA. If error rate creeps back up, we'll re-open page.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PD-8813 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. PagerDuty link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-8813
Sam (oncall): thanks team. I'll take the postmortem draft. Adding timeline and commands to INFRA-1294. Closing in 30m unless new issues. :thumbsup:
